title: God Made Everything, God Made Me
bigIdea: God made everything — and God made you on purpose.

memoryVerse.text: How you made me is amazing and wonderful.

moral.lesson: God made the whole world — the light, the sky, the land, the animals, and people. And out of everything He made, God also made YOU. You are part of God's good and wonderful creation.
moral.application: When you see the sky, the trees, and the animals, remember: the same loving God who made all of it made you too — and He is happy He did.

style: Flat-color children's cartoon storybook illustration, simple rounded shapes, soft warm colors, thick clean black outlines, bright and friendly, gentle lighting, 16:9 landscape composition, no text or words in the image, no letters.

beats.scene: God's creation beginning: a dark sky bursting into bright warm light, with a glowing sun, a moon, and twinkling stars appearing over a brand-new world.
text: In the very beginning, there was nothing at all.
Then God spoke — and there was light!
God made the bright sun, the gentle moon, and all the twinkling stars.

beats.scene: A beautiful brand-new world: green mountains, deep blue seas and rivers, tall trees and colorful flowers under a sunny blue sky.
text: God made the dry land and the deep blue seas.
He made tall mountains, flowing rivers, trees, and flowers of every color.

beats.scene: A lush green world full of happy animals God made: birds flying, fish swimming in a river, a lion, an elephant, rabbits, and butterflies, all cheerful.
text: Then God filled the world with animals!
Birds to fly, fish to swim, and creatures big and small — God made them all.

beats.scene: A happy man and woman standing in a beautiful green garden full of plants and friendly animals, smiling, warm sunlight.
text: God looked at everything He had made, and it was very good.
Then God made the very first people to know Him and enjoy His world.

beats.scene: A cheerful young child with short brown hair stands outdoors with arms open wide, smiling up at a bright sky, surrounded by trees, flowers, and a friendly animal, full of joy.
text: Out of the whole big world, God chose to make you on purpose.
God made everything — and you are part of His wonderful work.
